scope: F03 actual Windcrag Mardu / Zurgo Thunder's Decree / All-Out Assault combat composition only
compatibility_scope: Accepted exact All-Out pair adopted by integrator; exclude compatibility ancestor from scenario-only integration. No engine/card changes in this workstream.

full_oracle_facts.name: All-Out Assault
full_oracle_facts.oracle_text:
Creatures you control get +1/+1 and have deathtouch.
When this enchantment enters, if it's your main phase, there is an additional combat phase after this phase followed by an additional main phase. When you next attack this turn, untap each creature you control.

full_oracle_facts.name: Windcrag Siege
full_oracle_facts.oracle_text:
As this enchantment enters, choose Mardu or Jeskai.
• Mardu — If a creature attacking causes a triggered ability of a permanent you control to trigger, that ability triggers an additional time.
• Jeskai — At the beginning of your upkeep, create a 1/1 red Goblin creature token. It gains lifelink and haste until end of turn.

full_oracle_facts.name: Zurgo, Thunder's Decree
full_oracle_facts.oracle_text:
Mobilize 2 (Whenever this creature attacks, create two tapped and attacking 1/1 red Warrior creature tokens. Sacrifice them at the beginning of the next end step.)
During your end step, Warrior tokens you control have "This token can't be sacrificed."

obligations: Actual supported Windcrag exact1RW paid and Mardu named entry; established mature actual Zurgo battlefield, exact2RWB paid actual All-Out entry/anthem/next-attack callback and inserted phase chain.

All-Out leaves before attack. Windcrag makes two Mobilize2 packets plus exactly one delayed untap packet; delayed nonpermanent ability is not duplicated. Stack order untap-first yields exactly four red1/1 Warrior tokens tapped/attacking and exactly five attackers, with no attack-declaration recursion.

Departed All-Out untaps actual Zurgo and idle own creature while enemy remains tapped. Branch removes Zurgo before end attempts or keeps it: ordinary real phase progression reaches own end step; allfour tokens sacrificed or allfour protected.

Owned trigger-order root clones raw/index/sibling, disposes parent, compares exact snapshots, rejects wrong actor/invalid packet transactionally, restores and rejects stale index, then replays. Opposite real trigger order produces untapped four Warriors rather than tapped four, both private observations preserve secret hand. Both player seats.

reused_existing_proofs.extent: Complete actual All-Out scenarios and support helpers read. Existing tests retain exact additional-combat/main ordering, callback-only-next-attack and off-main exclusion; F03 adds only composed scheduling assertion and actual downstream interactions.

artifact_policy: Native Rust ELF/rlib tests; mutable Cargo compiled outputs are transient. Retained source/report/log hashes provide historical provenance, without claiming required/preserved cdylib bytes.
